goal: Use a small batch of animation references to fill distinct missing Movement Lego evidence instead of collecting duplicate motions.
rules: Prefer a new missing Lego block over a duplicate unless the duplicate adds a materially different mechanic.
Each source is classified KEEP_STUDY, MAYBE, or SKIP.
Raw FBX binaries are not committed while redistribution/license status is unverified.
A source can support multiple Lego blocks, but one primary block is assigned for hunt accounting.
Animation evidence supplies 3D mechanics; paired MoveNet FRONT + SIDE evidence will be collected separately.
CANDIDATE means useful evidence exists; it does not mean validated or runtime-ready.

entries.huntEffect: Ground → Stand changes from EMPTY to CANDIDATE
entries.notes: Strong floor-to-upright root rise and approximately 99 degrees of root pitch recovery over the 4.4 second Mixamo animation.

entries.huntEffect: Knee Drive L and Knee Drive R change from EMPTY to CANDIDATE
entries.notes: 0.7 s / 22 root keys. Left thigh X spans about -14.5° to 49.8°, right thigh about -23.2° to 56.4°; lower legs show large alternating flexion ranges. Strong bilateral knee-drive mechanics.

entries.huntEffect: Stand → Jump and Vertical Jump change from EMPTY to CANDIDATE
entries.notes: Very short 0.233 s / 8-key takeoff fragment, so it is partial rather than a full jump cycle. Kept because it adds distinct takeoff evidence; requires later comparison with a longer jump reference.

entries.huntEffect: Jump → Land changes from EMPTY to CANDIDATE
entries.notes: 2.0 s / 61 root keys. Hips descend to about 48 source units during the clip before recovering near 88; large bilateral thigh/lower-leg rotation ranges capture landing absorption and stabilization.

entries.huntEffect: Split Stance changes from EMPTY to CANDIDATE
entries.notes: 1.267 s / 39 root keys with about 120.29 source units of lateral root translation. Left/right thigh and lower-leg ranges are materially asymmetric, making it useful split/low-stance evidence; not yet a validated lunge template.
